name: Production release policy
description: The default rules for shipping to production. Written to be readable by someone who will not read the code that enforces it.

rules.statement: Production cannot ship with an unresolved High or Critical finding.
rules.rationale: A verified finding at this severity that nobody has resolved is a known, unmitigated problem.

rules.statement: Production cannot ship while a High or Critical candidate is still unproven.
rules.rationale: Neither proven nor refuted is not the same as fine. The release decision cannot be made, which is different from failing it.

rules.statement: A fixed High or Critical finding must carry passing regression proof.
rules.rationale: A fix nobody tested is a claim that it was fixed.

rules.statement: A High or Critical finding must have survived an independent refutation attempt.
rules.rationale: The reviewer agreeing with itself is not verification.

rules.statement: Code that moves money requires a race and idempotency review.
rules.rationale: Money paths fail under retry and concurrency, and those failures are invisible to a single-request review.

rules.statement: An MCP tool with write capability requires an explicit authorization review.
rules.rationale: A tool that can write runs with the operator's authority on whatever text reached the model.

rules.statement: An internet-facing URL fetcher requires an SSRF review.
rules.rationale: Destination validation that happens before a redirect is not destination validation.
